verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-data API with an SDK, CLI, and MCP server. Scheduling recurring jobs is a plausible feature for such a platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents no way to define or schedule recurring jobs or workflows. Price-tracking subscriptions with webhooks are a related event-driven monitor, not a user-defined schedule. CLI use from scripts would only be a user-side cron workaround, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
